storyBand.headline: We believe clothing should breathe, soften with time, and carry the dignity of human hands.
storyBand.body: Every seam in our studio begins with unhurried dialogue between master weavers, natural dyers, and pattern cutters. We produce in intentional, limited runs of twenty to fifty pieces per silhouette—preventing landfill surplus and keeping your wardrobe distinctly personal.

ctaSection.headline: Personal styling & bespoke inquiries

about.title: A return to unhurried sartorial craftsmanship.
about.lead: Founded in 2021 as a quiet rebellion against mass-produced synthetic clothing, Aura & Thread Atelier is a slow fashion sanctuary honoring natural textile traditions.
storyParagraphs: Our story started in the handloom clusters of Maheshwar, Bengal, and Chanderi. Watching generational weavers turn raw organic threads into ethereal textiles made one truth undeniable: the most luxurious garments in the world are not fabricated by machines in cold factories, but by people who weave poetry into every weft.

Today, our small design studio works directly with over thirty weaving families and independent tailoring units. We eliminate intermediaries to ensure weavers receive honest living wages, while our patrons receive pieces cut from textiles you simply cannot find on high street racks.

values.title: Single-Batch Integrity
values.description: We never mass-manufacture. Each silhouette is produced in batches capped at fifty pieces, numbered and never re-issued once fabric runs end.

values.title: Natural Fiber Purity
values.description: 100% GOTS-certified handspun cotton, Chanderi silk-cotton, and Mulberry silk. Biodegradable, skin-kind, and made to breathe in warm climates.

values.title: Fair Artisan Honoraria
values.description: We pay 40% above fair-trade standard rates directly to our artisan guilds, supporting artisanal craft preservation across generational communities.

values.title: Zero-Waste Patterning
values.description: Off-cuts and fabric remnants are transformed into matching textile pouches, hair accessories, and artisan gift tags. Nothing goes to waste.

curationProcess.headline: How We Pick & Craft Every Piece

steps.title: Textile Discovery
steps.description: We travel directly to artisanal weaving hubs across Madhya Pradesh, Bengal, and Gujarat to hand-select ethically spun yarn and natural vat dyes.

steps.title: Anatomical Drape Testing
steps.description: Each silhouette is drafted, sampled on diverse Indian body profiles, and wear-tested over four weeks to verify all-day comfort and mobility.

steps.title: Single-Needle Tailoring
steps.description: Master tailors finish each dress with French seams, concealed deep pockets, hand-stitched hem bindings, and natural mother-of-pearl buttons.
